title: SAP REFX Senior Consultant
description:
SAP REFX Lead for Onsite in UAE! 
 Minimum 10+ years of overall SAP experience, with substantial hands-on SAP RE-FX functional consulting experience. Strong expertise in SAP RE-FX configuration and real estate business processes. Experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA RE-FX. In-depth knowledge of real estate object management and contract management. Strong experience with lease-in and lease-out contracts, rental conditions, rent adjustments, and recurring postings. Understanding of service charge settlement, security deposits, and property-related financial postings. Good understanding of IFRS 16 lease accounting, including right-of-use (ROU) assets, lease liabilities, depreciation/amortization, and interest postings. Strong integration knowledge of SAP FI/CO, FI-AA, MM, and AP/AR. Experience in functional specifications, testing, data migration, and production support. Ability to troubleshoot configuration issues and work effectively with technical teams. 
 Experience and Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. At least one end-to-end SAP RE-FX implementation or transformation project; multiple implementations preferred. Experience in real estate, property management, leasing, facilities management, or corporate real estate environments. Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills. SAP certification in RE-FX or relevant SAP Finance modules is an advantage. Preferred Skills Experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance and modern SAP architecture. Knowledge of ASC 842, where relevant to the client. Experience with SAP Fiori, reporting, and analytics. Experience integrating SAP RE-FX with third-party lease management or property management systems. Experience in multinational, multi-company-code, or large real estate portfolio environments.

Key Skills: Consulting,Senior,SAP Refx,Refx,SAP Flexible Real Estate Management,SAP,Management,Real estate
